about_the_game:
Step into the world of Exercise your Demons, a short 2d narrative adventure inspired by Irish fairies and folklore. You will take the role of a character who is struggling to find a job and finds some reprieve thanks to your uncle's friend who gives you a chance.

Meet and befriend 5 locals while you work towards settling into the small fictional town called Inishsióg in County Galway, Ireland. The locals are not normal people but who is to say what is normal. The locals are known as tricksters and sometimes even bad omens. Be sure to be a welcoming, helping hand or else the consequences will be dire.

C'mere, meet some familiar faces like:

  • St. Patrick - The patron saint himself. He manages the gym and is a local publican with an apetite for a good pint.

  • Chaointe Doran - A shy singer known for her weeping and wailing when she's said to see someone go.

  • Púca Cleasaí - A trickster known for causing everyone trouble. There's a rumour around town that this tool can transform but no one has any proof.

Go to work at the gym or travel around multiple locations around the town and endulge in the local drinks and cuisine while you find the locals at their usual spots.

Give it a lash!

content_descriptors.notes:
There is no visible gore but the text is aimed at a mature audience. The bad endings are grim just like the depictions of Irish fairies in Irish mythos.

Seeing as this game is set in Ireland there is also a depction of a local pub which has some story elements that show alcohol use.
